title: The Family Heirloom
description: Bandits ran me off the Crossroads road and I dropped my mother's ring in the grass. It is worth nothing as gold. My knees will not carry me back to look.

objectives.description: Search the Crossroads road where she was run off

notes: Threat: an old woman ran off the Crossroads road by bandits, too frail to walk back for what she dropped. Giver motive: family memento, three generations, shame at asking a stranger for something so small. Consequence of refusal: unwired - she keeps the hole in her family's history.
